problem: On the real device the 「直接问小事哥」 tab page (pages/ai-chat) showed a duplicated/over-tall white header stack that pushed the first chat bubble far down. Root cause: env(safe-area-inset-top) was applied TWICE — once (correctly) by the xsg-navbar component, and again by the .msg-list content container (.msg-list { padding-top: calc(24rpx + env(safe-area-inset-top)) }). On a notched device that stacked a second ~44–59rpx inset between the compact title row and the first bubble. Fix: drop the duplicate inset so the top inset is owned ONCE by the navbar; the chat list keeps a plain 24rpx top gap. Chat bubbles, bottom input bar, tabBar and AI logic are untouched.

forensics.custom_nav_component: xsg-navbar title="直接问小事哥" light
forensics.TOP_SPACER_HEIGHT: 0 at top (the 200rpx view is a BOTTOM scroll-clearance spacer)

safeAreaOwnership: env(safe-area-inset-top) now applied exactly ONCE on this page (xsg-navbar). env(safe-area-inset-bottom) unchanged on the input bar.
note: tests/ui/part-b/*.test.js cannot run in this worktree (missing tests/ui/helpers/pageShim) — pre-existing at base commit ad2bafb, unrelated to this CSS-only change.
